full_sentence: Although I was very nervous, I answered every question clearly.
acceptable_variants: I managed to answer all the questions.

options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, not a contrast. 'Although' needs a clause that contrasts with the first part of the sentence.

options.text: because the interview room was small.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' gives a reason. 'Although' signals contrast, not cause.

options.text: the room had two chairs and a table.
options.why_wrong: This describes the setting but does not contrast with feeling nervous.

explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that shows contrast with the first part of the sentence. Cause clauses and descriptions of the setting do not complete the contrast.
translation: Embora estivesse muito nervoso, respondi a cada pergunta com clareza.
